cards.meaning: rather than X, better to Y (weighing two options and favoring the second)
cards.example: 与其等合同，不如先把涡轮机订下来。
cards.examplePinyin: Yǔqí děng hétong, bùrú xiān bǎ lúnjī dìng xiàlái.
cards.exampleMeaning: Rather than wait for a contract, better to reserve the turbines first.
cards.note: Formal/书面语 advanced connective, HSK 4, common in financial commentary for weighing strategic tradeoffs. Contrasts with the plainer 比起…更 ('compared to X, more Y'), which just ranks two things — 与其…不如 specifically frames a decision, implying the speaker is recommending the second option over the first, not just comparing them.
cards.tiesTo: Energy segment — Vistra's queue-cull-first posture versus PPL-Blackstone's build-ahead-of-contract bet on gas turbines

cards.meaning: when you get down to it, in the final analysis (cutting through to the core claim)
cards.example: 说到底，TileRT的论点是软件的灵活性胜过硬件的专用性。
cards.examplePinyin: Shuōdàodǐ, TileRT de lùndiǎn shì ruǎnjiàn de línghuóxìng shèngguò yìngjiàn de zhuānyòngxìng.
cards.exampleMeaning: When you get down to it, TileRT's argument is that software flexibility beats hardware specialization.
cards.note: Upper-register abstract collocation, HSK 4, used to summarize a whole argument down to its core claim — a step more measured and analytical than the blunter, more casual 说白了 ('to put it bluntly'), which a speaker reaches for to cut through niceties rather than to close out a reasoned analysis.
cards.tiesTo: Deep Dive — SemiAnalysis's TileRT piece, where GPU fungibility beats purpose-built ASIC hardware

cards.meaning: broken up, dissolved (an alliance, relationship, or organization coming apart)
cards.example: Nabuwag ang alyansang UniTeam nang malantad ang tunay na kasunduan noong 2022.
cards.exampleMeaning: The UniTeam alliance broke up when the real 2022 agreement was exposed.
cards.note: Specifically for relationships, alliances, or organizations coming apart — distinct from bumagsak (already taught, used for something physical or abrupt, like a building or a price, giving way all at once). Nabuwag is the precise word for a political alliance dissolving, not just failing.
cards.tiesTo: Philippines — Rep. Sandro Marcos's account of how the 2022 Marcos-Duterte alliance actually fell apart

cards.meaning: worsened, intensified (a bad situation growing more severe, not just more frequent)
cards.example: Lumala ang bilang ng mga namatay dahil sa tuluy-tuloy na pag-ulan.
cards.exampleMeaning: The death toll worsened because of the continuing rain.
cards.note: Describes an existing bad situation intensifying, distinct from a simple count going up — it signals the whole crisis is deepening, not just one number changing, which is why it fits a rising, still-active flood death toll rather than a single data point.
cards.tiesTo: Philippines — the habagat/tropical-storm flood death toll rising through the week
